descriptionChirho: Qal: to feel deep loathing or abhorrence toward something or someone, with beth of the object; used of Rebekah's weariness with life (Gen 27:46), God's disgust at nations (Lev 20:23), Israel's loathing of manna (Nu 21:5), and general abhorrence (Pr 3:11, 1Ki 11:25)

Qal: to feel anxious dread or terror in the face of a threatening presence, with mippenei of the feared party; used of Egypt's dread of Israel (Ex 1:12), Moab's dread of Israel (Nu 22:3), and dread of hostile kings (Is 7:16)
Hiphil causative: to cause sickening dread or terror in someone (Is 7:6, of the plot against Judah)
